content.text: {"class": "TEST_CODE_DEFECT", "reasoning": "The test harness's AuthSupport caches a 900s-TTL token in a static field with no expiry check or refresh, and the cache hit at age 1057s sent an already-expired bearer token, so the 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED is the correct product behavior.
